raw.rationale: Halcinonide is a potent glucocorticoid receptor agonist, and glucocorticoids are known to selectively kill lymphoid malignancies but not the listed solid tumor lineages; PRISM single-agent screens show GR agonists have minimal lineage-selective activity in adherent solid cancer lines. Thus probabilities are low across all listed lineages, with slight elevation only where GR expression/dependency is sporadically reported (e.g., breast, skin).
